newsitem.title: USA: Motorola installs cellular system in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Motorola installs cellular system in Peru.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Monday its Cellular Infrastructure Group installed a Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) cellular telephone system in Peru, making it the first CDMA commercial service in Latin America.

Telefonica del Peru plans to initially offer cellular service to more than 10,000 customers in Lima, Motorola said. The CDMA technology will eventually enable the Latin American company to expand to 20,000 digital mobile telephone subscribers, Motorola said.
Motorola has more than 50 agreements for commercial deployment of CDMA systems and trials with mobile telephone service providers worldwide.
The company's stock was up 1/2 Monday afternoon at 54-1/4.
